# spaceman profile

Harness profiles: list, show, create and update.

Aliases: `profiles`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman profile create`](#spaceman-profile-create) | Add a harness profile |
| [`spaceman profile get`](#spaceman-profile-get) | Show a harness profile (ID or slug) |
| [`spaceman profile list`](#spaceman-profile-list) | Harness profiles |
| [`spaceman profile update`](#spaceman-profile-update) | Edit a harness profile (only the flags given change) |

## spaceman profile create

Add a harness profile.

```sh
spaceman profile create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `save-harness-profile` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--harness` | string |  | claude-code or codex (required) |
| `--model` | string |  | model |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |

## spaceman profile get

Show a harness profile (ID or slug).

```sh
spaceman profile get <profile> [flags]
```

API: `get-harness-profile` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman profile list

Harness profiles.

```sh
spaceman profile list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-harness-profiles` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman profile update

Edit a harness profile (only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman profile update <profile> [flags]
```

API: `get-harness-profile`, `save-harness-profile` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--model` | string |  | model |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |
